Module.Name: iris-governed-fhir-agent
Module.Description: Governed, patient-scoped FHIR R4 tools for InterSystems AI Hub agents and external MCP clients. Requires IRIS for Health with AI Hub enabled (EAP build); will not compile on a stock community image. Installing only loads and compiles classes - call GovernedFHIR.Setup.Install:Run() yourself to create a demo FHIR endpoint.
